notes: Darwin's 'fishes' (including the electric fishes and flying-fish) is the paraphyletic grade 'Pisces', which has no GBIF backbone or NCBI node; resolved to the Wikidata item for fish. Electric rays, teleosts, ganoids, Cobitis and Lepidosiren have their own entries.
resolution_notes: GBIF backbone has no node for this taxon (it only carries kingdom to species ranks, or treats the name as a synonym/doubtful).
